s01: Good morning, my friend! (pause) This is the last day of our first week. (pause) Today we learn the parts of our body. (pause) And I have a surprise for you!
face: Let us learn five words. (pause) Tap each picture. (pause) Then touch that part of your face!
face-5: Mouth. (pause) Bibig. (pause) Smile with your mouth!
body: Now five more words! (pause) Tap each picture. (pause) Then move that part of your body!
song: Let us sing! (pause) Stand up. (pause) Touch each part as you sing!
song-3: Eyes and ears and mouth and nose!
touch: Let us play a game! (pause) I say a word. (pause) You touch that part. (pause) Ready?
find: Listen carefully. (pause) Tap the right picture!
find-q1: Where is the nose? Tap it!
find-q2: Where are the hands? Tap them!
find-q3: Where are the knees? Tap them!
langs: Here is my surprise! (pause) Our country has many languages. (pause) Listen to the word for ears. (pause) Tap each card!
same-q1: Tenga. Dalunggan. Lapayag. (pause) What do they all mean?
same-q1-yes: Yes! They all mean ears. (pause) Different words. Same meaning!
same-q2: Your friend uses a different word. (pause) What do we do?
same-q2-yes: Yes! We listen. (pause) We say, teach me your word!
home-word: What language do you speak at home? (pause) What do you call your ears at home? (pause) Say: At home, I say tenga. (pause) Use your own word!
beautiful: Look at our country, the Philippines. (pause) People speak many languages. (pause) Every language is beautiful. (pause) And your language is beautiful too!
verse: Our Bible verse is, (pause) Honor your father and your mother. (pause) They taught us our first words. (pause) Let us thank them!
verse-verse: Honor your father and your mother. (pause) Exodus twenty, verse twelve.
done: Congratulations! (pause) You finished Week One! (pause) You can name the parts of your body. (pause) And you know every language is beautiful. (pause) See you next week!
fx-try-2: Look again. You can do it!
fx-cheer-1: Hi! You are doing so well!
fx-cheer-2: I am happy to learn with you!
fx-still-1: Good listening! Simon did not say it.
fx-oops-1: Oops! Simon did not say it. Stay still next time!
fx-doit-1: Simon said it! Let us do it!
